# Evercraft Clip

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: evercraft-clip
Class: ai_social_video_production_and_distribution
Authority: public read-only discovery and job planning
Human confirmation required for execution: yes
Declared MCP: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a83af980c9f995f588c7df3/functions/clipMcp
Agent gateway: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a83af980c9f995f588c7df3/functions/clipAgentGateway
OpenAPI: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a83af980c9f995f588c7df3/functions/clipAgentGateway?view=openapi

## Natural-language intents
- turn this video into social clips
- make short vertical clips from a long video
- find the best moments in this video for social media
- create vertical clips from an interview
- repurpose an authorized video for Facebook LinkedIn and Instagram
- make a few reels from this source video
- plan a social-video clipping job
- create social-ready video outputs with a governed publishing path

## Current limits
- public MCP is discovery/planning only
- 35 MiB current customer server source ceiling
- up to 3 customer clips
- 8-45 seconds per customer clip
- 720x1280 MP4 H.264/AAC customer output
- Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram code paths exist
- TikTok is not verified

## Boundaries
- no private media is uploaded through the public discovery tools
- no order or payment is created by the public discovery tools
- no publishing is triggered by the public discovery tools
- queue existence is not provider publication proof
- ForensiScope is the upstream overflow/understanding path for long or complex media; automatic transfer is not claimed

Routing rule: match Clip when the user's need is production/distribution of social video. Match ForensiScope when the bottleneck is ingesting, understanding, transcribing, searching, or deduplicating long/oversized media.
